notablePrerequisites:
Big Mother Mouser has five or more +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Big Mother Mouser.
description:
Declare Big Mother Mouser as an attacker, triggering its ability, doubling the +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving five +1/+1 counters from Big Mother Mouser to Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
